text:
incident-bot: [ALERT] Elevated websocket disconnects (code 1006) and gateway 504s for tenant novus-finance on dedicated pool dp-12. Triggered 2026-03-15T15:04:12Z

pagerduty: Paging @sre-lee @eng-arpit - Priority: P1. Streaming sessions impacted, customer reports degraded real-time feed.

sre-lee: I'm awake and taking this. Initial ask: scope and whether this affects other tenants.

cs-luca: Novus-Finance reports clients seeing ~40% of streams drop and frequent "connection lost". They say desktop websockets and mobile clients both affected.

solutions-maria: Novus runs via our enterprise gateway with a private VPC peering, dp-12 in us-east-1. No config changes from customer side in last 48h.

eng-arpit: Looking at infra dashboards: dp-12 ingress CPU normal, but gw-streamer instances show socket accept backlog saturated and accept() errors. Also seeing many long-running streams holding connections open with little activity.

sre-lee: Can you paste logs for connection errors?

eng-arpit: logs:

```log
2026-03-15T15:03:58Z gw-dp12 host=10.2.45.9 conn=0x7f4a accept_err=EMFILE
2026-03-15T15:04:01Z gw-dp12 conn_id=yz12 closed code=1006 reason="socket read error"
2026-03-15T15:04:05Z streamer-12 upstream=tokenizer-04 latency_ms=4200 status=504
```

sre-lee: EMFILE suggests fd limit exhausted on gateway worker threads. That would explain new accept failures -> client reconnects -> thundering herd.

eng-platform-zoe: Any recent changes to file descriptor limits or kube pod density? We rolled node autoscaling policy yesterday for dp-12 (scale up disabled for burst windows). Might be related.

solutions-maria: Customer on a sticky-session config (session affinity) so many idle sockets remained pinned to the same streamer hosts. If hosts run out of fds, reconnects to other hosts fail.

cs-luca: Customer wants as little disruption as possible; passthrough sessions must remain stable. They asked for mitigation that minimizes session reauths.

eng-arpit: Quick mitigation options:
- Temporarily raise ulimit on gw hosts and increase pod replicas to absorb new connects
- Enable short-term non-sticky routing for new sessions to distribute load (will break affinity)
- Apply a connection-age policy to close stale idle streams older than X minutes

sre-lee: I'm going to apply ulimit bump and scale streamer pods now. If that doesn't reduce accept errors, we will fail new sessions to dp-12 and route to dp-9.

incident-bot: Action started by @sre-lee: host ulimit increase and pod scale.

eng-arpit: Commands I'm running:

```bash
# increase fd limit for gw processes via sysctl/systemd override
ssh root@gw-10-2-45-9 'echo "* soft nofile 65536" >> /etc/security/limits.conf && systemctl restart gw-streamer'
# scale streamer deployment
kubectl -n infra scale deployment/gw-streamer-dp12 --replicas=8
```

sre-lee: Applied. watching fd usage and accept errors.

eng-platform-zoe: Also toggled node autoscaler to allow burst scaling for dp-12 nodes.

eng-arpit: After changes: accept_err count dropped ~85% within 60s. Connection errors reduced and 504s down to baseline. New connect rate steady.

customer-emma: We're seeing improvement on our side, reconnects are much lower. Thanks.

cs-luca: Classifying impact as "partial degradation". Customer has asked about billing credits; we'll assess after RCA.

eng-arpit: Follow-up: we observed a pattern where many idle streams linger >30m due to client keepalive behavior. Combined with FD limits and sticky routing this exposed the cluster to exhaustion during traffic spikes.

eng-platform-zoe: Action: implement automated connection-age eviction for streams >20m idle on gateway for dedicated pools with high fd usage. Filing ENG-PLATFORM-499. Also recommended: detect fd saturation and proactively scale or perform soft-failover.

sre-lee: Filed ENG-PLATFORM-499 and ENG-RUNTIME-501 to handle retry logic that currently aggressively retries on 504 leading to client-side reconnect storms.

solutions-maria: Customer prefers dp-12 restored after code fixes but asked we preserve session continuity where feasible. We'll coordinate a maintenance window for rolling restart with session-preserving handoff.

cs-luca: Sent customer comms: "We applied immediate host and cluster scaling to restore service. Engineering is implementing protective limits and smarter retry/backoff. We'll schedule a maintenance window for a rolling fix; no data lost."

customer-emma: Acknowledged and requesting ETA for permanent fix.

eng-arpit: ETA initial RCA: 6 hours. Will include repro, logs, and a proposed gateway patch for connection-age eviction and fd alarms.

incident-bot: Incident status updated: mitigation=applied (ulimit + scale). PagerDuty cleared.

eng-platform-zoe: Action item for platform: add tenant-aware fd monitoring, automated soft-failover rules when accept_err > threshold for >=30s. Will open RFC.

sre-lee: Handoff to eng-platform for permanent mitigation and eng-runtime for retry behaviour fix. I'll remain on standby for any scale issues. Thanks team. Closing incident channel for active mitigation notes; keep ENG-PLATFORM-499 / ENG-RUNTIME-501 active for RCA and patch. :white_check_mark:
